An HR Executive is responsible for finding, screening, and hiring qualified candidates for job openings. They manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including job posting, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and making job offers. title: Sr. IT Recruiter
description:
REQUIREMENT SUMMARY

The Talent Acquisition Specialist plays a crucial role in our ITES sector, focusing specifically on acquiring top IT and technology talent. Working from either Bangalore or Mumbai, this position demands a strategic approach to sourcing and managing candidates, ensuring the alignment of recruitment strategies with organizational goals.

Description

\- Minimum 2\-5 years of experience in talent acquisition with a focus on IT/Technology recruitment.  
\- Strong understanding of technology skills and the ability to interpret IT job descriptions effectively.  
\- Proven hands\-on experience with sourcing platforms such as Naukri and LinkedIn.  
\- Excellent candidate screening, communication, and negotiation skills.  
\- Ability to manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously while maintaining a focus on quality and timelines.  
\- Demonstrated ability to meet recruitment targets in a fast\-paced environment.  
\- Strong stakeholder management skills to effectively liaise with hiring managers and team members.

Key Responsibilities

\- Manage end\-to\-end IT recruitment for technical and technology positions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and timelines.  
\- Translate hiring needs and job descriptions into effective sourcing strategies to attract top talent.  
\- Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and databases, maintaining a strong network and pipeline of potential hires.  
\- Screen candidates rigorously based on technical skills, experience, and role fit, ensuring only the best candidates advance.  
\- Conduct initial discussions and coordinate technical and client interviews, acting as the main point of contact for candidates.  
\- Facilitate offer negotiations, manage documentation, and oversee joining formalities to ensure smooth onboarding.  
\- Track and report recruitment metrics, including submissions, interviews, selections, offers, and joiners, to optimize recruitment processes.  
\- Build and maintain a talent pool for frequently hired technology skills, anticipating future hiring needs.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
